title: Identification of diagnostic gene biomarkers and immune infiltration in patients with diabetic kidney disease using machine learning strategies and bioinformatic analysis.
summary: LASSO, SVM-RFE and random forest selected DUSP1 and PRKAR2B from training expression cohorts; separate GEO cohorts and kidney-tissue IHC were used for validation. Validation AUCs were 0.789 and 0.709, below training values. This is a narrow retrospective biomarker finding, not clinical diagnostic deployment.
